EvidenceFamily.description: Evidence family (K30). Several facts from one family count as one confirmation.

oneOf.description: Price and indicators computed from price.
Traded volume.
Money flow: settlement, institutional (broker) flow.
Derivatives (futures, options).
News and fundamentals.

LedgerStat.description: Ledger statistic for one key (meaning kind + detector), as seen at some time.

n.description: Closed capsules counted (realized + invalidated + expired; never retracted).

MeaningCondition.description:
A machine-checkable condition attached to a meaning (sentence slot).

(R4, K42/A28) The same shape serves two different roles, which a story keeps in two
separate fields ([`Story::condition`], [`Story::resolution`]):

- **state condition** (durum koşulu): whether the claim still holds **now** ("RSI is
  above 70", "the close is still above the broken level"); it decides the capsule's
  [`Validity`];
- **expected resolution** (beklenen çözüm): how the story is expected to close ("a
  close outside the band within 20 bars"); a state may have ended while the story is
  still open.

On a fact ([`FactMeaning::condition`]) the role follows from the time kind
(`qp_capsule::sentence::split_condition`): a state's condition with `within_bars` is
its expected resolution, an expectation's condition is what resolves it, and every
other condition is a state condition.

key.description: Evidence key of the threshold value.

within_bars.description: Within how many bars (expectation), if bounded.

MeaningKind.description: The six meaning kinds (K30). The glyph's shape encodes this.

oneOf.description: Devam: the move goes on (trend, MA alignment, flag).
Dönüş: the move may be turning (divergence, double top/bottom).
Kırılım: a boundary was crossed (range, channel, support/resistance).
Sıkışma: the move is narrowing; direction unknown (band squeeze, low volatility).
Aşırılık: unusual stretch (overbought/oversold, outside the band).
Akış: money in/out independent of price (volume, settlement, institutional flow).

Resolution.description:
How a story is expected to close (R4, K42/A28: the **expected resolution**, kept apart
from the state condition).

condition.description:
The resolution the detector names, if any (a squeeze: "a close outside the band
within 20 bars"; an expectation: its condition).

rule.description:
The outcome rule that closes the story (`barrier`: the per-kind volatility
barrier, M5); its natural life is [`Story::horizon_bars`].

Stage.description:
Lifecycle stage of a capsule story (K28, K37):
`candidate → born → strengthened | weakened → confirmed → realized | invalidated |
expired | retracted`.

oneOf.description:
Aday: seen on an open bar; only on the watching replica; never in the authority's
log or the ledger.
Doğdu: finalized on bar close; the authority gave it an id.
Güçlendi: a new supporting fact of the same family.
Zayıfladı: a fact against it, or its state weakened.
Teyit edildi: a second (or further) independent evidence family supports it.
Gerçekleşti: the outcome rule says it came true. Closes; ledger hit.
Geçersiz: its invalidation happened. Closes; ledger miss.
Süresi doldu: its natural life (in bars) ended without an outcome. Closes; ledger miss.
Geri çekildi: the data it rested on proved wrong (K37). Closes; NOT in the ledger.

TimeKind.description: The three time kinds of a capsule (K27).

oneOf.description: Olay: happened at a bar; past tense with its time; freshness fades.
Durum: holds while the condition holds; present tense; ends when it breaks.
Beklenti: conditional; lives until the condition is met or voided.

Transition.description: One transition in a capsule's story.

bar.description: Bar index (of the story's bar series) at which it happened.

Trust.description: How a capsule reached the user; drives the "verified by" mark (K38).

oneOf.description: The replica can re-check it on its own data (consistency rule, §19).

Server fact: the replica cannot re-check it (licensed data); shown as verified
by the server.

description: The story a capsule tells (R3). Optional on [`crate::Capsule`].

born_bar.description: Bar the story was born on.

condition.description:
(R4, K42/A28) The **state condition**: whether the claim still holds now (from the
fact that gave birth). Absent when the claim has none (a squeeze's band, an
expectation) and on stories written before R4.

families.description: Independent evidence families that support it (sorted, unique).

horizon_bars.description: Natural life in bars from birth (expiry by bar count, never by clock).

importance.description: Importance score from the ranking rule (higher = more important).

ledger_at_birth.description: Ledger at birth: only capsules closed before the birth bar (no look-ahead).

ledger_key.description:
Ledger key (`kind/direction/detector@version`; R4, K42/A23: up, down and neutral
stories of one detector are counted apart).

resolution.description:
(R4, K42/A28) The **expected resolution**: how the story is expected to close.
Absent on stories written before R4.

series.description: The bar series the story lives on.

theme.description: Theme key: same instrument + same theme → one story (K28).

tier.description: Importance tier: 1 most important … 3 least (sensitivity filters on it).
